-- OR-1: Bonamici (D) vs John Verbeek (R) — fix "Total Write-ins" as candidate1
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Suzanne Bonamici',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'John Verbeek',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Solid D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Suzanne Bonamici (D) seeking reelection. R primary: Barbara Kahl vs John Verbeek. D primary: Bonamici vs Jamil Ahmad. Bonamici has held this seat since 2012.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 1;

-- OR-2: Cliff Bentz (R) vs Democratic nominee — fix duplicate and add D candidate
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Cliff Bentz',
  candidate1_party = 'R',
  candidate2_name = 'TBD (D Primary)',
  candidate2_party = 'D',
  rating = 'Solid R',
  notes = 'Incumbent Cliff Bentz (R) seeking reelection. R primary: Bentz vs Andrea Carr and Peter Larson. D primary: 6 candidates including Chris Beck, Mary Doyle, Rebecca Mueller, Peter Quince, Dawn Rasmussen, Patty Snow. Eastern Oregon is deeply red.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 2;

-- OR-3: Maxine Dexter (D) vs Loran Ayles (R) — fix "Total Write-ins"
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Maxine Dexter',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Loran Ayles',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Solid D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Maxine Dexter (D) seeking reelection. Previously held by Earl Blumenauer (retired 2024). Dexter won special election in 2024. D primary: Dexter vs Andrew Castilleja and Jessica Salas. Portland-area district is safely Democratic.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 3;

-- OR-4: Val Hoyle (D) vs Monique DeSpain (R) — fix "Total Write-ins", update rating to Toss-up
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Val Hoyle',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Monique DeSpain',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Lean D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Val Hoyle (D) seeking reelection. D primary: Hoyle vs Dan Bahlen and Melissa Bird. R primary: Monique DeSpain vs Stefan Strek. Eugene/Corvallis district, competitive in recent cycles. Rated Lean D.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 4;

-- OR-5: Janelle Bynum (D) vs Patti Adair (R) — fix "Total Write-ins", update rating to Toss-up
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Janelle Bynum',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Patti Adair',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Toss-up',
  notes = 'Incumbent Janelle Bynum (D) seeking reelection. Bynum flipped this seat in 2024 (beat Lori Chavez-DeRemer by ~1%). D primary: Bynum vs Zeva Rosenbaum. R primary: Patti Adair vs Jonathan Lockwood. Rated Toss-up by most outlets — one of the most competitive House races in 2026.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 5;

-- OR-6: Andrea Salinas (D) vs David Russ (R) — fix duplicate candidate2
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Andrea Salinas',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'David Russ',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Lean D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Andrea Salinas (D) seeking reelection. Salinas won this new district in 2022 and 2024. D primary: Salinas runs unopposed. R primary: David Russ. Willamette Valley/SW Oregon district.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district = 6;

-- KY-3: Morgan McGarvey (D) vs Republican nominee — fix candidate1 duplicate
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Morgan McGarvey',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'TBD (R Primary)',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Solid D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Morgan McGarvey (D) seeking reelection. McGarvey runs unopposed in D primary. R primary: Daniel Cobble, David Nichter, Donald Pay, Maria Teresa Rodriguez. Louisville district is safely Democratic.'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = 3;

-- KY-4: Thomas Massie (R) vs Ed Gallrein (R) primary — the most watched House primary
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Thomas Massie',
  candidate1_party = 'R',
  candidate2_name = 'Ed Gallrein',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  rating = 'Solid R',
  notes = 'Incumbent Thomas Massie (R) faces Trump-endorsed challenger Ed Gallrein in the most expensive House primary in history ($25M+ in ad spending). Trump endorsed Gallrein and called Massie a "loser." D primary: Jesse Brewer vs Melissa Strange. Northern Kentucky district is safely Republican regardless of primary winner.'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = 4;

-- KY-6: Open seat (Barr running for Senate) — update rating to Lean R
UPDATE house_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'Ralph Alvarado',
  candidate1_party = 'R',
  candidate2_name = 'Zach Dembo',
  candidate2_party = 'D',
  rating = 'Lean R',
  notes = 'Open seat — Andy Barr (R) vacating to run for U.S. Senate. R primary: Ralph Alvarado (Trump-endorsed), Ryan Dotson, Adam Perez Arquette, Greg Plucinski, Steve Shannon. D primary: Zach Dembo (frontrunner, leads fundraising), Cherlynn Stevenson, Erin Petrey, David Kloiber. Lexington-area district rated Lean R as open seat.'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND district = 6;
